The following findings are based on the current source package.</p><table><thead><tr><th><p><strong>Priority</strong></p></th><th><p><strong>Task</strong></p></th><th><p><strong>Implementation Instruction</strong></p></th><th><p><strong>Definition of Done</strong></p></th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><p><strong>P0</strong></p></td><td><p>No Shopify connection</p></td><td><p>Current package uses React/Vite with local dummy product data.</p></td><td><p>Replace dummy data layer with Shopify Storefront API through Hydrogen.</p></td></tr><tr><td><p><strong>P0</strong></p></td><td><p>Cart is not real commerce</p></td><td><p>Cart drawer and product actions are prototype logic.</p></td><td><p>Implement Shopify cart creation, line add/update/remove, totals and persistence.</p></td></tr><tr><td><p><strong>P0</strong></p></td><td><p>Checkout is not connected</p></td><td><p>Checkout button does not complete a Shopify checkout journey.</p></td><td><p>Use the Shopify cart checkout URL to redirect to hosted checkout.</p></td></tr><tr><td><p><strong>P0</strong></p></td><td><p>MCX prices are hard-coded</p></td><td><p>MetalRates.jsx contains fixed gold/silver values and timestamp.</p></td><td><p>Replace with server-side delayed-rate service and resilient UI states.</p></td></tr><tr><td><p><strong>P0</strong></p></td><td><p>Bulk order feature is missing</p></td><td><p>No homepage component, route, quote form or workflow exists.</p></td><td><p>Add homepage CTA + dedicated bulk orders page + server-side quote submission.</p></td></tr><tr><td><p><strong>P1</strong></p></td><td><p>Routing is incomplete</p></td><td><p>Several footer/header links resolve to 404; Product photography/data readiness can extend the schedule.</p><table><thead><tr><th><p><strong>Window</strong></p></th><th><p><strong>Primary Work</strong></p></th><th><p><strong>Output</strong></p></th><th><p><strong>Gate</strong></p></th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><p>Days 1-2</p></td><td><p>Freeze UI, Git backup, Shopify store/channel access</p></td><td><p>Stable baseline + migration branch</p></td><td><p>No new dummy features</p></td></tr><tr><td><p>Week 1</p></td><td><p>Shopify product schema + Hydrogen migration</p></td><td><p>Current homepage running in Hydrogen/Oxygen</p></td><td><p>Build/deploy successful</p></td></tr><tr><td><p>Week 2</p></td><td><p>Routes + 20-SKU pilot + PLP/PDP/search</p></td><td><p>Real Shopify catalogue browsing</p></td><td><p>Product/variant data correct</p></td></tr><tr><td><p>Week 3</p></td><td><p>Cart + checkout + payment + customer state</p></td><td><p>End-to-end test order</p></td><td><p>Order appears in Shopify Admin</p></td></tr><tr><td><p>Week 4</p></td><td><p>MCX delayed rates + Bulk Orders + internal pages</p></td><td><p>Custom service features complete</p></td><td><p>Error states and submissions verified</p></td></tr><tr><td><p>Week 5</p></td><td><p>SEO, analytics, performance + 600-700 SKU import</p></td><td><p>Production catalogue</p></td><td><p>Data QA sample passes</p></td></tr><tr><td><p>Week 6</p></td><td><p>UAT, responsive QA, security, launch rehearsal</p></td><td><p>Release candidate</p></td><td><p>Owner sign-off</p></td></tr><tr><td><p>Week 7-8 if required</p></td><td><p>Content/data cleanup, photography replacement, post-UAT fixes</p></td><td><p>Final production launch</p></td><td><p>No P0/P1 launch blockers</p></td></tr></tbody></table><p><strong>PHASE 0  |  FREEZE, BACKUP &amp; REPOSITORY DISCIPLINE</strong></p><p><strong>Objective: </strong>Protect the approved UI and stop accumulating prototype-only debt.</p><table><thead><tr><th><p><strong>Priority</strong></p></th><th><p><strong>Task</strong></p></th><th><p><strong>Implementation Instruction</strong></p></th><th><p><strong>Definition of Done</strong></p></th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><p><strong>P0</strong></p></td><td><p>Create a clean Git repository/branch strategy</p></td><td><p>Commit the current working prototype as a tagged baseline. Create a dedicated production-migration branch. Exclude node_modules, .env and local build output.</p></td><td><p>Current prototype can be restored at any time; secrets are not tracked.</p></td></tr><tr><td><p><strong>P0</strong></p></td><td><p>Freeze homepage visual hierarchy</p></td><td><p>Do not redesign section order while commerce migration is underway. Only make agreed refinement fixes.</p></td><td><p>Homepage screenshot remains visually recognisable after migration.</p></td></tr><tr><td><p><strong>P1</strong></p></td><td><p>Inventory reusable components</p></td><td><p>Mark components as reusable, to be migrated, or obsolete. Preserve Header, Hero, ProductCard, rails, banners, promise, story and footer where possible.</p></td><td><p>A component migration checklist exists before coding starts.</p></td></tr><tr><td><p><strong>P1</strong></p></td><td><p>Clean build assets</p></td><td><p>Move temporary static assets into valid public/import paths so development builds do not silently rely on root files.</p></td><td><p>Production build contains all required temporary assets until Shopify media replaces them.</p></td></tr></tbody></table><p><strong>PHASE 1  |  SHOPIFY BASIC &amp; do not switch production DNS until UAT passes.</li></ul><h2>1.2 Product &amp; Variant Schema - Define Before Import</h2><table><thead><tr><th><p><strong>Priority</strong></p></th><th><p><strong>Task</strong></p></th><th><p><strong>Implementation Instruction</strong></p></th><th><p><strong>Definition of Done</strong></p></th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><p><strong>P0</strong></p></td><td><p>Create product categories/collections</p></td><td><p>At minimum: Silver Jewellery, Gold Jewellery, Rings, Necklaces, Earrings, Bracelets, New Arrivals, Bestsellers, Gifts.</p></td><td><p>Handles and navigation mapping are stable and documented.</p></td></tr><tr><td><p><strong>P0</strong></p></td><td><p>Define SKU/variant rules</p></td><td><p>Use M.V SKU as primary internal SKU. Ring size/colour/purity variations must be variants rather than duplicated products where appropriate.</p></td><td><p>20-SKU pilot proves all required variant patterns.</p></td></tr><tr><td><p><strong>P0</strong></p></td><td><p>Create jewellery metafields</p></td><td><p>Create structured metafields for metal, purity, gross weight, net weight, stone type, stone colour, finish, gender, occasion, style, hallmark/certification information, care and dimensions.</p></td><td><p>PDP and filters read structured fields rather than parsing descriptions.</p></td></tr><tr><td><p><strong>P1</strong></p></td><td><p>Create collection metafields</p></td><td><p>Optional fields for hero media, subtitle, SEO copy and collection editorial content.</p></td><td><p>Collection templates can render marketing content without hard-coded page-specific JSX.</p></td></tr><tr><td><p><strong>P1</strong></p></td><td><p>Define product status/content rules</p></td><td><p>Draft products stay hidden; publish only complete products with price, inventory, primary image, SKU and required attributes.</p></td><td><p>No incomplete product can appear on storefront.</p></td></tr></tbody></table><h2>1.3 20-SKU Pilot Dataset</h2><p>Do not begin the full 600-700 SKU upload yet. Client components receive only required public data.</p></td><td><p>No secret appears in built JS or browser network source code.</p></td></tr><tr><td><p><strong>P1</strong></p></td><td><p>Deploy staging to Oxygen</p></td><td><p>Connect repository/deployment and create a shareable staging URL.</p></td><td><p>Owner can review every milestone on a stable staging site.</p></td></tr><tr><td><p><strong>P1</strong></p></td><td><p>Add error boundaries</p></td><td><p>Implement route-level 404/500 behavior and graceful data failure UI.</p></td><td><p>Storefront never renders a blank screen on API failure.</p></td></tr></tbody></table><p><strong>PHASE 3  |  ROUTING &amp; GLOBAL PAGE SHELL</strong></p><p><strong>Objective: </strong>Create a stable route map so navigation, SEO and analytics can be implemented once.</p><table><thead><tr><th><p><strong>Route</strong></p></th><th><p><strong>Template / Purpose</strong></p></th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><p>/</p></td><td><p>Homepage</p></td></tr><tr><td><p>/collections/silver-jewellery</p></td><td><p>Silver landing/PLP</p></td></tr><tr><td><p>/collections/gold-jewellery</p></td><td><p>Gold landing/PLP</p></td></tr><tr><td><p>/collections/rings</p></td><td><p>Rings PLP</p></td></tr><tr><td><p>/collections/necklaces</p></td><td><p>Necklaces PLP</p></td></tr><tr><td><p>/collections/earrings</p></td><td><p>Earrings PLP</p></td></tr><tr><td><p>/collections/bracelets</p></td><td><p>Bracelets PLP</p></td></tr><tr><td><p>/collections/new-arrivals</p></td><td><p>New arrivals PLP</p></td></tr><tr><td><p>/collections/gifts</p></td><td><p>Gifting landing</p></td></tr><tr><td><p>/products/:handle</p></td><td><p>PDP</p></td></tr><tr><td><p>/search</p></td><td><p>Search</p></td></tr><tr><td><p>/wishlist</p></td><td><p>Wishlist</p></td></tr><tr><td><p>/cart</p></td><td><p>Cart</p></td></tr><tr><td><p>/account</p></td><td><p>Customer account entry</p></td></tr><tr><td><p>/pages/metal-rates</p></td><td><p>Metal rates</p></td></tr><tr><td><p>/pages/bulk-orders</p></td><td><p>Bulk &amp; support gift message/attributes only if approved.</p></td><td><p>Cart drawer and cart page never disagree.</p></td></tr><tr><td><p><strong>P0</strong></p></td><td><p>Checkout redirect</p></td><td><p>Retrieve Shopify Cart checkoutUrl and send customer to hosted Shopify checkout.</p></td><td><p>Test order completes and appears in Shopify Admin.</p></td></tr><tr><td><p><strong>P0</strong></p></td><td><p>Payment test</p></td><td><p>Configure approved payment gateway in Shopify and execute test/small real transaction per gateway rules.</p></td><td><p>Success, failure and cancellation paths are understood and documented.</p></td></tr><tr><td><p><strong>P1</strong></p></td><td><p>Order attribution/analytics</p></td><td><p>Ensure Hydrogen/storefront channel attribution and analytics events are present.</p></td><td><p>Purchase can be traced back to storefront channel and marketing analytics.</p></td></tr></tbody></table><table><tr><td><p><strong>CHECKOUT RULE: </strong>Do not build a custom React card/UPI form. Shopify checkout/payment integrations should handle sensitive payment entry.</p></td></tr></table><p><strong>PHASE 6  |  MCX GOLD &amp; SILVER RATE INTEGRATION</strong></p><p><strong>Objective: </strong>Replace hard-coded prices with a compliant, server-side delayed market reference service.</p><p><img src="data:image/png;base64," /></p><h2>6.1 Business / Data Subscription Prerequisite</h2><ul><li>M.V must obtain the required MCX data subscription/permission directly or through an authorised data distributor before public website display.</li><li>For a public website, implement delayed MCX data, not a frontend claim of unrestricted real-time/live MCX data.</li><li>Choose the exact Gold and Silver instruments/contracts to display and document the contract/expiry selection rule.</li><li>Do not scrape exchange pages or use an undocumented third-party endpoint in production.</li></ul><h2>6.2 Server-Side Implementation</h2><table><thead><tr><th><p><strong>Priority</strong></p></th><th><p><strong>Task</strong></p></th><th><p><strong>Implementation Instruction</strong></p></th><th><p><strong>Definition of Done</strong></p></th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><p><strong>P0</strong></p></td><td><p>Provider adapter</p></td><td><p>Create metalRates.server.ts that fetches the approved provider/MCX feed and maps vendor-specific fields into M.V normalized fields.</p></td><td><p>Changing vendor requires changing adapter, not UI components.</p></td></tr><tr><td><p><strong>P0</strong></p></td><td><p>Cache and refresh</p></td><td><p>Cache the delayed rate; target 30-60 second internal refresh unless the provider agreement/API specifies otherwise.</p></td><td><p>100 visitors do not trigger 100 provider calls.</p></td></tr><tr><td><p><strong>P0</strong></p></td><td><p>Validation</p></td><td><p>Reject missing/negative/obviously malformed prices and timestamps. Keep last-known-good response with status STALE when appropriate.</p></td><td><p>Bad vendor payload never displays Γé╣0 or corrupt values.</p></td></tr><tr><td><p><strong>P0</strong></p></td><td><p>API endpoint</p></td><td><p>Expose a storefront endpoint such as /api/metal-rates containing normalized non-secret data only.</p></td><td><p>Browser response contains no API key/token.</p></td></tr><tr><td><p><strong>P0</strong></p></td><td><p>Status handling</p></td><td><p>Return marketStatus OPEN/CLOSED/STALE/UNAVAILABLE plus updatedAt and delayMinutes.</p></td><td><p>Frontend communicates data freshness clearly.</p></td></tr><tr><td><p><strong>P1</strong></p></td><td><p>Rate page</p></td><td><p>Create /pages/metal-rates with market-reference explanation, timestamp, selected contract/expiry details and disclaimer.</p></td><td><p>Customer can distinguish MCX market reference from M.V jewellery selling price.</p></td></tr><tr><td><p><strong>P1</strong></p></td><td><p>Logging/alerts</p></td><td><p>Log provider failures and repeated stale data; optional error monitoring.</p></td><td><p>Operations team can diagnose rate outages.</p></td></tr></tbody></table><h2>6.3 Normalized API Contract</h2><p>GET /api/metal-rates<br />{<br />  "source": "MCX",<br />  "feedType": "delayed",<br />  "delayMinutes": 1,<br />  "marketStatus": "open",<br />  "updatedAt": "2026-08-16T17:03:00+05:30",<br />  "gold": {<br />    "symbol": "GOLD",<br />    "expiry": "YYYY-MM-DD",<br />    "price": 0,<br />    "unit": "10g",<br />    "change": 0,<br />    "changePercent": 0<br />  },<br />  "silver": {<br />    "symbol": "SILVER",<br />    "expiry": "YYYY-MM-DD",<br />    "price": 0,<br />    "unit": "kg",<br />    "change": 0,<br />    "changePercent": 0<br />  }<br />}</p><h2>6.4 Homepage Component States</h2><ul><li>OPEN: show rates, change %, MCX ΓÇó DELAYED and last-updated time.</li><li>CLOSED: show last market rate and MARKET CLOSED; do not animate as if values are moving.</li><li>STALE: show last available rate + ΓÇ£Last updated ΓÇªΓÇ¥ and a subtle stale indicator.</li><li>UNAVAILABLE: show ΓÇ£Market data temporarily unavailableΓÇ¥; never substitute zero or a made-up rate.</li></ul><table><tr><td><p><strong>PRICING DISTINCTION: </strong>MCX reference rates must not be presented as the final selling price of M.V jewellery. Product prices include product-specific purity, weight, making/stone costs, taxes and business pricing rules.</p></td></tr></table><p><strong>PHASE 7  |  BULK &amp; CORPORATE ORDERS</strong></p><p><strong>Objective: </strong>Add the missing B2B entry point and quote workflow without damaging the premium retail journey.</p><p><img src="data:image/png;base64," /></p><h2>7.1 Homepage Placement</h2><p>Insert the new section in Home after GiftBanner and before PromiseSection:</p><p>&lt;OccasionGrid /&gt;<br />&lt;GiftBanner /&gt;<br />&lt;BulkOrderBanner /&gt;<br />&lt;PromiseSection /&gt;<br />&lt;BrandStory /&gt;</p><h2>7.2 Homepage Content</h2><p><strong>Eyebrow: </strong>FOR BUSINESS &amp; CELEBRATIONS</p><p><strong>Heading: </strong>Bulk &amp; Corporate Jewellery Orders</p><p><strong>Body: </strong>Planning corporate gifting, wedding jewellery, retail requirements or a large-volume purchase? M.V Ornaments offers personalised assistance for bulk orders and special requirements.</p><p><strong>Primary CTA: </strong>REQUEST A BULK QUOTE</p><p><strong>Route: </strong>/pages/bulk-orders</p><h2>7.3 Quote Form Fields</h2><ul><li>Full name *</li><li>Company/organisation</li><li>Phone *</li><li>Email *</li><li>GSTIN</li><li>City *</li><li>Business type: Corporate / Retailer / Distributor / Wedding-Event / Personal / Other</li><li>Expected quantity: 25-50 / 50-100 / 100-250 / 250-500 / 500+</li><li>Products interested in / selected products and quantities</li><li>Required-by date</li><li>Custom packaging: Yes/No</li><li>Additional requirements</li><li>Consent/acknowledgement checkbox if required by privacy policy</li></ul><h2>7.4 Recommended V1 Processing</h2><p>1.  Submit through a server-side endpoint; validate and rate-limit the request.</p><p>2.  Store request in an approved database/CRM or send structured email to the sales/admin team; avoid only client-side mailto behavior.</p><p>3.  M.V team reviews stock, requested quantity, delivery date and market/pricing conditions.</p><p>4.  After approval, create a Shopify Draft Order manually in Shopify Admin and send the approved invoice/checkout link to the buyer.</p><p>5.  Automate Draft Order creation later only after V1 process and permissions are stable.</p><p><strong>PHASE 8  |  INTERNAL PAGES &amp; CUSTOMER JOURNEYS</strong></p><p><strong>Objective: </strong>Complete every route already exposed by the navigation/footer and make each page production-ready.</p><table><tr><td><p><strong>Page / Template</strong></p></td><td><p><strong>Minimum V1 Content</strong></p></td></tr><tr><td><p><strong>Silver/Gold landing</strong></p></td><td><p>Editorial hero, category discovery, featured collection, SEO copy.</p></td></tr><tr><td><p><strong>Category PLP</strong></p></td><td><p>Breadcrumb, H1, count, filters, sort, 2-column mobile / 4-column desktop target, load-more/pagination.</p></td></tr><tr><td><p><strong>PDP</strong></p></td><td><p>Media gallery, price, variant/size, availability, delivery check placeholder/integration, add to bag, details accordions, recommendations.</p></td></tr><tr><td><p><strong>Search</strong></p></td><td><p>Search box, results count, product grid, related terms, empty state.</p></td></tr><tr><td><p><strong>Wishlist</strong></p></td><td><p>Persistent saved products, add-to-bag, empty state. V1 guest persistence may use local storage.</p></td></tr><tr><td><p><strong>Account</strong></p></td><td><p>Customer account entry and order history using Shopify-supported customer account architecture.</p></td></tr><tr><td><p><strong>Gifting</strong></p></td><td><p>Recipient/occasion/budget discovery and premium gifting content.</p></td></tr><tr><td><p><strong>Metal Rates</strong></p></td><td><p>MCX reference data, explanation and disclaimer.</p></td></tr><tr><td><p><strong>Bulk Orders</strong></p></td><td><p>Dedicated quote page/form as defined above.</p></td></tr><tr><td><p><strong>About</strong></p></td><td><p>Brand story, Quality With Creativity, values and craftsmanship.</p></td></tr><tr><td><p><strong>Size Guide</strong></p></td><td><p>Ring/bracelet/necklace measuring instructions.</p></td></tr><tr><td><p><strong>Jewellery Care</strong></p></td><td><p>Silver/gold/stone care content.</p></td></tr><tr><td><p><strong>Contact / FAQ</strong></p></td><td><p>Support channels and accordion FAQ.</p></td></tr><tr><td><p><strong>Policy pages</strong></p></td><td><p>Shipping, returns, privacy, terms; content supplied/approved by M.V, not invented by developer.</p></td></tr><tr><td><p><strong>404 / error</strong></p></td><td><p>Premium empty state with home/shop links.</p></td></tr></table><p><strong>PHASE 9  |  SEO, ANALYTICS, PERFORMANCE &amp; ACCESSIBILITY</strong></p><p><strong>Objective: </strong>Make the custom React storefront indexable, measurable, fast and usable before the catalogue scales.</p><table><thead><tr><th><p><strong>Priority</strong></p></th><th><p><strong>Task</strong></p></th><th><p><strong>Implementation Instruction</strong></p></th><th><p><strong>Definition of Done</strong></p></th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><p><strong>P0</strong></p></td><td><p>Route metadata</p></td><td><p>Unique title, meta description, canonical and robots behavior for home, collection, product and content routes.</p></td><td><p>No important route shares only the homepage metadata.</p></td></tr><tr><td><p><strong>P0</strong></p></td><td><p>Server-rendered commerce content</p></td><td><p>Important product/collection title, price, availability and copy must be present in server-rendered HTML.</p></td><td><p>View-source/server response contains core page content.</p></td></tr><tr><td><p><strong>P1</strong></p></td><td><p>Structured data</p></td><td><p>Add valid Organization/WebSite on site level; Product/Offer/BreadcrumbList on applicable pages.</p></td><td><p>Schema validation has no critical errors.</p></td></tr><tr><td><p><strong>P1</strong></p></td><td><p>Analytics</p></td><td><p>Track view_item_list, select_item, view_item, add_to_cart, view_cart, begin_checkout, purchase, search, wishlist, metal_rate_view and bulk_order_submit.</p></td><td><p>Events fire once with correct product/value context.</p></td></tr><tr><td><p><strong>P1</strong></p></td><td><p>Performance</p></td><td><p>Optimise hero and product media, lazy-load below fold, reserve image dimensions, avoid unnecessary client JS and large app bundles.</p></td><td><p>Mobile release candidate passes agreed performance review/Core Web Vitals target.</p></td></tr><tr><td><p><strong>P1</strong></p></td><td><p>Accessibility</p></td><td><p>Semantic headings, keyboard navigation, visible focus, labels, alt text, contrast and usable touch targets.</p></td><td><p>Critical purchase journey can be completed by keyboard and basic accessibility audit passes.</p></td></tr><tr><td><p><strong>P1</strong></p></td><td><p>Sitemap/robots</p></td><td><p>Ensure Shopify/headless routing has production sitemap and correct robots behavior.</p></td><td><p>Published products/collections are discoverable; staging is not indexed.</p></td></tr></tbody></table><h2>Homepage SEO Content Baseline</h2><p><strong>Title: </strong>M.V Ornaments | Premium Silver &amp; Gold Jewellery Online</p><p><strong>H1: </strong>Modern Jewellery, Crafted to Shine</p><p><strong>Meta description: </strong>Shop premium silver and gold jewellery at M.V Ornaments. Discover elegant rings, necklaces, earrings, bracelets, gifts and contemporary designs crafted for every occasion.</p><p><strong>PHASE 10  |  FULL 600-700 SKU MIGRATION</strong></p><p><strong>Objective: </strong>Scale the catalogue only after the pilot proves the data model and commerce path.</p><h2>10.1 Import Gate</h2><p>Proceed to full import only when all of the following are true:</p><ul><li>20 pilot SKUs display correctly on PLP/PDP</li><li>Variants and inventory behave correctly</li><li>Cart and checkout complete successfully</li><li>Metafields drive filters and product details</li><li>Shopify images display correctly with no broken asset paths</li><li>SEO metadata is generated per product/collection</li><li>Owner has approved naming, price and product-data conventions</li></ul><h2>10.2 Full Import Process</h2><p>1.  Clean and validate master product spreadsheet.</p><p>2.  Generate/import Shopify-compatible product data in controlled batches (for example 100-150 products at a time).</p><p>3.  Attach correct media and alt text.</p><p>4.  Assign collections/tags/metafields.</p><p>5.  Spot-check every batch before proceeding.</p><p>6.  Reconcile SKU counts, inventory and pricing between source sheet and Shopify.</p><p>7.  Publish only complete products.</p><h2>10.3 Data Quality Checks</h2><ul><li>Duplicate SKU</li><li>Duplicate handle</li><li>Missing primary image</li><li>Missing price</li><li>Invalid compare-at price</li><li>Inventory mismatch</li><li>Incorrect metal/purity</li><li>Variant size mapping</li><li>Incorrect collection</li><li>Broken alt text / filename dependency</li><li>Out-of-stock behavior</li><li>Product draft/published status</li></ul><h1>11. QA, UAT, Security &amp; Launch</h1><table><tr><td><p><strong>LAUNCH GATE: </strong>Do not switch the main domain until all P0 issues are closed and M.V has completed a successful end-to-end test order on the release candidate.</p></td></tr></table><h2>11.1 Device / Browser Matrix</h2><ul><li>Mobile: 360, 375, 390, 412/430 px representative widths</li><li>Tablet: portrait and landscape representative devices</li><li>Desktop: 1366 and 1440+ widths</li><li>Chrome, Safari/WebKit, Edge; current mainstream mobile browser engines</li><li>Real-device test for at least one iPhone and one Android device if available</li></ul><h2>11.2 Commerce UAT Scenarios</h2><ul><li>Browse home -&gt; silver -&gt; ring -&gt; PDP</li><li>Select ring size -&gt; add to bag</li><li>Update quantity -&gt; remove -&gt; re-add</li><li>Discounted product compare-at pricing</li><li>Out-of-stock variant cannot be purchased</li><li>Search exact and broad term</li><li>Apply filters/sort and use browser back button</li><li>Wishlist save/remove</li><li>Begin checkout as guest</li><li>Successful payment/order</li><li>Payment failure/cancel then return</li><li>Order confirmation and Shopify Admin order record</li><li>Metal rate normal/closed/unavailable state</li><li>Bulk quote submission and admin receipt</li><li>404 and broken-route check</li><li>Policy/footer links</li></ul><h2>11.3 Security / Release Checklist</h2><ul><li>No secrets in client bundle or repository</li><li>Production environment values configured in Shopify/Oxygen</li><li>Staging environment protected from search indexing</li><li>Forms have validation and anti-spam/rate limiting</li><li>MCX/provider endpoint is server-side and cached</li><li>Checkout uses Shopify URL and HTTPS</li><li>Error messages do not expose tokens/internal stack details</li><li>Remove unused prototype packages/assets and console debug logs</li><li>Run dependency/security review before launch</li><li>Back up product master data before bulk import</li></ul><h2>11.4 DNS &amp; Launch Sequence</h2><p>1.  Freeze production content changes during final launch window.</p><p>2.  Run final build and staging UAT.</p><p>3.  Confirm Shopify checkout/payment production mode.</p><p>4.  Configure main storefront domain to Hydrogen/Oxygen.</p><p>5.  Configure checkout domain/subdomain according to Shopify headless setup and final DNS plan.</p><p>6.  Verify SSL, redirect rules, canonical host and www/non-www behavior.</p><p>7.  Place one live low-value order and verify order, email and fulfilment workflow.</p><p>8.  Monitor logs, checkout conversion and error rate closely for the first 48 hours.</p><h1>12. Post-Launch Stabilisation</h1><ul><li>Daily error/log review for first 7 days</li><li>Verify MCX timestamps and stale-state behavior each trading day</li><li>Check failed search terms and zero-result queries</li><li>Review abandoned-cart/checkout behavior</li><li>Review top collection/product traffic and mobile conversion</li><li>Fix broken images/metadata found after full catalogue indexing</li><li>Confirm bulk quote submissions are reaching the assigned team</li><li>Schedule first performance and SEO review after enough production traffic exists</li></ul><h1>13.
